in_marathi.name: Jothi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jothi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jothi is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Jnana', which means 'knowledge'. The name Jothi signifies the embodiment of knowledge and wisdom. In Hindu mythology, Jothi is a goddess revered for her vast knowledge and enlightenment. She is often depicted with a lamp or a book, symbolizing the illumination of knowledge and the pursuit of wisdom.
